reasoning: Recent Georgia polling in the last 45 days shows Democratic Sen. Jon Ossoff leading Republican Mike Collins by margins ranging from 4 to 9 points, so the current Senate margin is best summarized as D+4 to D+9, with a rough midpoint around D+6. The sources provided do not include a current 2026 Georgia presidential poll, so the answer is based on the Senate race only; Georgia’s statewide Cook PVI is R+5.

sources.name: The Hill / AARP poll
sources.details: AARP poll of 1,060 likely Georgia voters found Ossoff at 52% and Collins at 43%, a 9-point lead for Ossoff.

sources.name: Newsweek / Wick poll
sources.details: Wick poll of 1,175 likely voters found Ossoff at 46.7% and Collins at 42.9%, a 3.8-point lead for Ossoff.

sources.name: USA Today reporting Fox News / Beacon Research poll
sources.details: Fox News / Beacon Research poll found Ossoff at 56% and Collins at 43%, a 13-point lead for Ossoff.

sources.name: PollsMax polling average
sources.details: Polling average page for Georgia’s 2026 Senate race showed Ossoff at 48.5% and Collins at 42.4%, a D+6.1 average margin.
